_comment: Pinned engine bundle the Scan Pack router orchestrates (S3). Every engine emits native SARIF that build_sarif.py merges via _enrich_run. version_pin is the tested version. install_engines.sh downloads these into scan_pack/bin/ (verified against the upstream release checksums); scan_pack.py prefers scan_pack/bin/ over PATH. Add an engine here, not in code.

engines.name: semgrep
engines._comment: One run writes BOTH formats. The SARIF is kept exactly as Semgrep wrote it; the JSON copy ({out}.semgrep.json) is the only place Semgrep reports each rule's confidence, impact, likelihood and subcategory as typed fields, so post_process copies those four onto each SARIF result's properties.torana. The SARIF alone carries confidence only as a free-text tag and the other three not at all.

engines.name: trivy-fs
engines._comment: Dependency (SCA) scanning from the repo's own manifests and lock files. Emits Trivy's NATIVE JSON, converted by post_process -- same reason as trivy-image: Trivy's own SARIF puts package identity in prose. PREFERRED OVER OSV where the binary resolves, because Trivy parses the manifests ITSELF. The OSV route takes a package list assembled by hand (SKILL.md Step 2 shows a literal echo), so which manifest gets trusted is a judgement call made per run -- on pantheon-admin that is 294 pinned packages in requirements.txt versus 43 in pyproject.toml. Same inputs, different answers. Trivy removes that step.

engines.name: trivy-image
engines._comment: Emits Trivy's NATIVE JSON, not its SARIF, and post_process converts it. Trivy's own SARIF puts package identity in prose and has no field for fix status: measured on one image, ingesting it landed cve_id 0/366 and package_name 0/366, so the findings could not join a pkg: node. trivy_to_sarif.py reads the typed JSON fields instead and emits the Torana profile.

_deep_tier_comment: SC2 opt-in deep tier. NOT in `engines[]` on purpose — scan_pack.py's generic router never runs these; they are driven by their `runner` (vvah_run.py). install_engines.sh DOES provision them (method `source` = git clone + pip install into the isolated venv). VVAH has no releases/tags yet, so version_pin is the exact main-branch commit (git ls-remote, 2026-07-07) for reproducibility; bump it deliberately.
